title: R’ Yehudah ben Dostai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Makkot 7b: he says in the name of R’ Shimon ben Shatach, “If someone fled from the Land of Israel abroad, his verdict is not overturned.” Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading: “Dostai son of R’ Yehudah, in the name of R’ Shimon.” Hyman reports that [Tosefta Sanhedrin, at the end of chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Sanhedrin.3.5), reads Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Yehudah. [Bava Kamma 83b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.83b.20) has R’ Dostai ben Yehudah saying: “‘An eye for an eye’ means monetary compensation”; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim cites a manuscript reading R’ Yehudah ben Dostai.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=142) gives Makkot 7b. The corresponding passage at [Makkot 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Makkot.7a.6) has Rabbi Yehudah son of Dostai speaking in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Shatach. It distinguishes flight from the Land of Israel, when the verdict stands, from flight into it, when the case is heard again.

The [Dikdukei Soferim page for Makkot](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/dqEtAAAAYAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA1-PA9) gives Yehudah son of Dostai in its printed column and Dostai son of Rabbi Yehudah in its manuscript column. The latter has “in the name of Rabbi Shimon,” without ben Shatach. The editor cites Yuchasin and the Tosefta as parallels.

The consulted Tosefta reads Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Yehudah, abbreviated בר״י in Hyman. In [the Bava Kamma apparatus](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/nDNwrYJLAMkC?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA191), both main columns have Dostai son of Yehudah, and one manuscript variant in the notes has Yehudah son of Rabbi Dostai. Heilprin gives the Bavli notices under [Yehudah son of Dostai](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1628&lang=en) and [Dostai son of Yehudah](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=903&lang=en) and treats their relationship as uncertain.
